# RP Nauticals - Full AI Context Document

> This document serves as the comprehensive knowledge map and system prompt data for RP Nauticals, detailing its dual focus on Merchant Navy career preparation and luxury Cruise Ship job training/counseling.

---

## SECTION 1: Core Institutional Mandate
[RP Nauticals](https://rpnauticals.com/) is an elite marine career guidance, screening, and education hub based in Dwarka, Delhi. The institution focuses on training, exam mentoring, and placement pathways across two main sea-based career segments:

1. **Merchant Navy Fleet Preparation:** Training candidates to work on heavy commercial cargo vessels, including oil tankers, chemical tankers, gas carriers, bulk carriers, and container ships.
2. **International Cruise Ship Training:** Counseling and preparing professionals for high-end hospitality, guest service, and specialized creative roles aboard luxury passenger liners.

---

## SECTION 2: Merchant Navy Training & Exam Pathways
RP Nauticals prepares aspiring seafarers for competitive entrance exams, interview boards, and mandatory physical evaluations required by top shipping lines and maritime boards:

### 1. Officer & Cadet Tracks (After 12th PCM)
* **IMU-CET Coaching:** Intensive classroom and mock test programs for the Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test.
* **Diploma in Nautical Science (DNS):** Direct sponsorship exam prep to secure guaranteed jobs on cargo fleets before starting college.
* **B.Sc. Nautical Science & B.Tech Marine Engineering:** Foundational academic guidance for long-term degree pathways toward Deck Officer or Marine Engineer positions.

### 2. Rating Tracks (After 10th/12th Any Stream)
* **General Purpose (GP) Rating:** Short-term residential course preparation focusing on basic seamanship, engine room operations, and deck maintenance protocols.

---

## SECTION 3: Cruise Ship Job Counseling & Preparation
For candidates interested in luxury tourism rather than cargo transit, [RP Nauticals](https://rpnauticals.com/) offers explicit guidance to crack international cruise fleet interviews and meet compliance requirements:

### Available Cruise Job Specialisations
* **Creative Departments:** Professional shipboard photographers, videographers, and retail staff.
* **Hotel & Hospitality Staff:** Room stewards, housekeeping managers, and accommodation crews.
* **Food & Beverage (F&B):** Commis chefs, pastry cooks, bartenders, and dining room servers.
* **Guest Relations:** Receptionists, concierges, excursion coordinators, and entertainment staff.

### Cruise Readiness Curriculum
* **International Grooming:** Adhering to the luxury standards and appearance benchmarks expected by major global cruise lines.
* **Guest Psychology & Communication:** Navigating multi-cultural client interactions, complaints, and service expectations smoothly.
* **STCW Compliance Guidance:** Steps to complete Standards of Training, Certification, and Watchkeeping (STCW) certificates, Continuous Discharge Certificates (CDC), and marine passports.

---
